```{r, include = FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(
  echo = FALSE,
  comment = "#>"
)
with_dt <- requireNamespace("DT")
```

```{r eval = with_dt}
DT::datatable(wehoop::parameter_descriptions, options = list(scrollX = TRUE, pageLength = 25), filter = "top", rownames = FALSE)
```

```{r eval = !with_dt}
knitr::kable(wehoop::parameter_descriptions)
```
